summary: Iteration 73 — BRSF Star Reward four-change verification (completed-month control, P05/N04 weekly children, N01 per-leave children, month-effective eligibility) — BACKEND + FRONTEND ALL GREEN. Backend regression: 21/21 pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_brsf_iter73.py against http://localhost:8001 (preview URL still Cloudflare-blocks python-requests). Coverage: (1) Completed-month guard — POST /api/brsf/recalculate rejects month=2026-09 and 2026-11 with 400 + 'September/November 2026 is not a completed month'; recalculate for a single Aug-2026 employee returns 200. Every mutating line endpoint on a Sep-2026 line returns 400 with 'completed month' text: PUT /brsf/stars/{id}/override, POST reset-override, PUT manual, POST instances, PUT child-override, POST child-override/reset. POST /brsf/import/preview for Sep-2026 also 400s while GET /brsf/export/{xlsx,csv} for Sep still returns 200 (viewing allowed). GET /brsf/summary and /brsf/stars both expose month_completed (False for Sep, True for Aug). (2) P05 weekly children — GET /brsf/stars carries child rows keyed 'week:YYYY-MM-DD' with system_value/override/final; bogus week key → 404, values 2 / -1 / 0.5 → 400. A +1 on week 1 flows through to parent (child_aggregate rises by 1), a second +1 on week 2 raises aggregate by another 1, a parent override of 0 makes final=0 while child_aggregate stays intact, POST /reset-override returns final to the aggregate, and POST /child-override/reset removes the child override cleanly. After POST /brsf/recalculate the same P05 child override is still present, exactly 14 parent lines exist, and week keys are unique (no duplicates). GET /brsf/audit contains an entry whose action starts with 'child override:week:...'. (3) N01 per-leave children — for Adwaid Suresh Aug-2026 (Preplanned + Paid + Emergency) every leave shows up with key='leave:...', an 'applicable' flag and 'leave_reason'; non-applicable rows have system_value=0. PUT child-override on a Paid/Emergency (non-applicable) key returns 400 'not covered by N01'. On the applicable leave: values -2, +1 and 0.5 all rejected (400); -1 succeeds, parent child_aggregate reflects -1, POST /child-override/reset returns the parent to its pre-test final. (4) Month-effective eligibility — GET /brsf/eligible-employees returns exactly Jun 24 / Jul 22 / Aug 21 / Sep 21 as per the main-agent probe; 'Sai Rupesh L' (inactive 2026-07-15) present in June, absent in July+Aug; 'Anuj Kumar' (inactive 2026-08-07) present in June+July, absent in Aug; 'Harshini V M' (confirmed 08-Apr-2026) absent in March, present in April. /brsf/summary rows counts match eligibility for Jun/Jul/Aug. CSV export includes 'sai rupesh' in June but NOT in July or August. Frontend UI smoke (HR admin, /star-reward Employees tab, preview URL): Sep-2026 (default) shows the amber brsf-incomplete-month-banner AND brsf-recalculate-btn disabled AND brsf-import-btn disabled (export xlsx/csv remain enabled). Switching the month-picker to Aug-2026 removes the banner AND re-enables Auto Calculate + Import; the picker label reads 'Aug 2026'; the table renders EXACTLY 21 rows for Aug-2026 (matches API eligibility). Screenshots captured: /tmp/sep_gated.png (banner+disabled) and /tmp/aug_active.png (21 rows, buttons enabled).
test_scenarios_verified: POST /brsf/recalculate for 2026-09 and 2026-11 → 400 with 'completed month' message; 2026-08 (single employee) → 200.
PUT override, POST reset-override, PUT manual, POST instances, PUT child-override, POST child-override/reset on Sep-2026 lines → 400 'completed month' (six endpoints).
POST /brsf/import/preview for Sep-2026 → 400; GET /brsf/export/{xlsx,csv} for Sep → 200.
GET /brsf/stars & /brsf/summary include month_completed=False for Sep, True for Aug; each employee has exactly 14 lines.
P05 children carry stable 'week:YYYY-MM-DD' keys with system_value/final; bogus key → 404; value ∈ {2,-1,0.5} → 400.
P05 +1 on 2 weeks → child_aggregate rises by 2; parent override 0 → final=0 while child_aggregate preserved; reset-override returns final to aggregate; child reset removes override.
P05 child override SURVIVES /brsf/recalculate (single-employee run) — no duplicate weeks, still 14 parent lines, audit entry action starts with 'child override:week:...'.

CSV export includes 'sai rupesh' in June only (NOT in July/August).
UI: /star-reward Employees Sep-2026 → brsf-incomplete-month-banner visible, brsf-recalculate-btn + brsf-import-btn disabled; Aug-2026 → banner gone, both enabled, 21 table rows.
critical_code_review_comments: brsf_stars.py is now 817 lines with routing + eligibility + weekly-bucket + N01 leave logic all in one module — recommend splitting eligibility (_month_bounds/_week_buckets/eligible_employees), CRITERIA_MAP/CHILD_DRIVEN_CODES/limits, compute_system_values (per-code system evaluators), and the FastAPI routes into their own files for maintainability.

In brsf_stars._get_line() the completed-month guard raises before the eligibility guard. Good defensive order, BUT the client only sees 'completed month' when BOTH conditions fail — the current wording is unambiguous, just noting it for future ordering changes.

brsf_child_override(): the payload's `note` is saved onto the child override AND sent to _audit() unchanged, so a very long note ends up in both places. Consider capping length or trimming whitespace.

brsf_child_override_reset() 404s when a key has never been overridden — good — but it does not verify the child key exists in system_children at all. If a stale key was already reset from a previous run, a second reset returns 404 with the same message ('No override on this child record'), which could confuse the caller. Consider distinguishing 'unknown key' vs 'no override present'.

_apply_child_overrides() computes `total += ch['final'] or 0` for every child, applicable or not. Since non-applicable children have system_value=0 AND cannot be overridden, this is currently safe, but the code would silently sum a non-zero override if the applicable-guard in the endpoint were ever bypassed. Consider guarding inside _apply_child_overrides() too.

Frontend BrsfFramework.jsx has grown to ~930 lines (up from 808 in iteration 71). The ChildOverrideDialog + Reset flow + monthCompleted gating make the case for extraction even stronger — recommend splitting OverrideDialog / ManualDialog / InstanceDialog / ChildOverrideDialog into separate files (also flagged in iterations 70/71).

StarReward.js STILL ships unreachable legacy dialogs (AutoStarDialog / BulkAutoStarDialog / EditStarsDialog / LeaveAdjustDialog / EntryOverrideDialog) — dead code from iteration 70's cleanup; safe to prune.

brsf_stars.eligible_employees() returns rows including 'inactive_date' & 'employee_status' — good — but does not expose the eligibility reason (e.g. 'inactive from 2026-07-15') to the UI. Adding a computed 'eligibility_note' field would let the UI display a tooltip for why a currently-active employee is absent from a past month.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner + disabled buttons on current month; enabled + 21 rows on completed month)

TestN01LeaveChildren placed a transient -1 on one applicable leave for Adwaid Suresh Aug-2026 and reset it in the same test. No residual data (fixture teardown_module cleared each key). The single-employee recalculate leaves audit entries behind, which is expected.
